instructions: Peel the 4 bananas and slice each one in half lengthwise.
Lay 2 halves in each of 4 bowls, cut side up.
Spoon 1 cup of the yogurt between the banana halves in each bowl.
Top each bowl with 1/2 cup of the blueberries and 3 tbsp of the gluten-free, nut-free granola.
method_notes: Choosing Chia is the lead: a split banana, yogurt in the middle, then berries and a crunchy topping. It has 2 ratings, so this is a fallback. The source calls for any yogurt and leaves the toppings open. This version uses plain yogurt, blueberries and a gluten-free, nut-free granola, so it keeps its gluten-free and nut-free tags. It is best put together just before eating, so the banana stays pale. You can portion the yogurt and berries ahead and slice the banana last.
